messages.content:
A person asked this in the Slack thread of an incident Argus is responding to:

what has Argus done about this so far?

This is everything Argus has recorded about the incident, oldest first:

- 2026-11-12T11:38:38Z Argus: Received HighErrorRate on io-shop
- 2026-11-12T11:38:48Z Argus: Moved the incident to INVESTIGATING - a worker took the incident up
- 2026-11-12T11:38:48Z Argus: Called in the Investigator Agent
- 2026-11-12T11:38:57Z Investigator Agent: Asked for the service's per-minute metrics, anchored on 11:38:18
- 2026-11-12T11:39:04Z Investigator Agent: Read back 360 minutes of metrics
- 2026-11-12T11:39:05Z Investigator Agent: Placed the start of the incident at 11:32
- 2026-11-12T11:39:06Z Investigator Agent: Recorded where the 3 replicas run - all on Tesla-V100-SXM2-16GB
- 2026-11-12T11:39:07Z Investigator Agent: Asked for production change events - deploys and releases, and flag changes from the flag provider's history, the 1 day 1 minute before Nov 12 11:33
- 2026-11-12T11:39:08Z Investigator Agent: Read back 1 production change
- 2026-11-12T11:39:08Z Investigator Agent: Read how far the deployment had rolled out - all 3 replicas run one revision, which the history does not name
- 2026-11-12T11:39:08Z Investigator Agent: Asked for the service's log lines, the 36 minutes 18 seconds before 11:38:18
- 2026-11-12T11:39:09Z Investigator Agent: Read back 124 log lines
- 2026-11-12T11:39:11Z Investigator Agent: Formed 1 candidate cause, best first: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched from off to on at 11:32:31. The newly enabled spend-summary path then raised ZeroDivisionError at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47 on account page requests, and the error rate rose from about 1% to 20-40%.
- 2026-11-12T11:39:11Z Investigator Agent: Read every channel available
- 2026-11-12T11:39:11Z Argus: Read the flag provider's history - 1 flag change by anyone but Argus, the 1 hour before 11:39:11
- 2026-11-12T11:39:16Z Argus: Moved the incident to MITIGATING to act on a candidate
- 2026-11-12T11:39:16Z Argus: Called in the Mitigation Agent
- 2026-11-12T11:39:25Z Mitigation Agent: Reverted the feature flag monthly-spend-feature for candidate cause #1, moved from ON to OFF
- 2026-11-12T11:39:36Z Mitigation Agent: Waiting to see whether the service is still at the incident's level, from 11:40 - up to 154s
- 2026-11-12T11:39:36Z Mitigation Agent: Looked at the service - no new minute read yet
- 2026-11-12T11:41:14Z Mitigation Agent: Looked at the service - no longer at the incident's level since 11:39
- 2026-11-12T11:41:14Z Mitigation Agent: Judged the action CONFIRMED
- 2026-11-12T11:41:14Z Argus: Moved the incident to MITIGATED - set flag [monthly-spend-feature] OFF and the rule that fired stopped firing
- 2026-11-12T11:41:21Z Code-Fix Agent: Proposed a fix as a draft pull request - https://github.invalid/ohadraz/repository/pull/1
- 2026-11-12T11:41:22Z Argus: Filed what was tried on this incident: reverting monthly-spend-feature
- 2026-11-12T11:41:53Z Postmortem Agent: Wrote the postmortem - The service broke at 11:32 UTC and was back to normal at 11:40 UTC, 8 minutes later. 29.6% of requests failed while it was broken, against 0.9% before it began. At its worst, 40.5% failed. The shop's takings fell short of the same hours on earlier weeks by 5,422.30 USD, beyond how much those hours vary on their own. Switching on a new monthly spending summary made the account page fail with a division by zero, likely for shoppers who had bought before but not yet this month. What Argus did: reverted the feature flag monthly-spend-feature (can be put back) - confirmed, still in place. Argus opened a draft fix, PR #1, for a person to review and merge. Switching monthly-spend-feature back on before a fix is in place could make account pages fail again in the same way.
- 2026-11-12T11:42:16Z Postmortem Agent: Wrote the executive synopsis
- 2026-11-12T12:13:42Z A person: Wrote in the incident's thread: what has Argus done about this so far?

Answer only from these lines. Where they do not hold the answer, say that the record does not say, rather than guessing. Do not say Argus will do anything; answer what happened.
Tell what a line says was measured or seen in that line's own words, never as another measure: a service no longer at the incident's level has left that level, which is not the same as being back to normal.

Call submit_answer with your answer.

tools.description: Submit your answer to the person's question about the incident.

answer.description: The answer, as it will be posted in the thread: a few plain sentences, addressed to the person who asked.
